name: Zijin Longking Co., Ltd.
summary: Zijin Longking Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells environmental protection equipment worldwide. It operates through two segments: Environmental Protection and New Energy. The company offers products and solutions for environmental protection; air pollution control; water pollution control; solid waste treatment; waste incineration power; and generation and hazardous waste disposal, as well as soil pollution control and remediation services; power generation, power transmission, power supply, and battery sales; and manufacturing of mining machinery and equipment.
